description_en: Invoke the ConfirmIoTCloudConnector API to confirm or deny the transfer of a cloud connector instance
description_zh: 调用ConfirmIoTCloudConnector接口确认或拒绝云连接器实例过户
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc confirm-iot-cloud-connector --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --confirm-status Confirm --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfirmIoTCloudConnector

parameters.help_en:
A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without confirming or denying the transfer of the cloud connector instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes all checks, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会确认或拒绝云连接器实例过户。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the cloud connector instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The confirmation status. Valid values:
Confirm: Confirm.
Refuse: Deny
parameters.help_zh:
确认状态。取值：

Confirm：确认。
Refuse：拒绝
parameters.name: confirm_status
